As one fern frond dies, one is born to take its place. This MAORI proverb of rebirth and regeneration is represented with a traditional fern coil design or koru, an integral symbol in MAORI art. Shown here in spiraling clusters, the symbol represents whakapapa, ancestry, or, essentially, a family tree.
